label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 122 ]

blocks.text: In recent years, Colombia has not received much money from its exports. Its major export crop is coffee but the demand for coffee in the world has dropped. Also, other countries have begun to export more coffee, so the price has fallen. Finally, the Colombian government has encouraged the farmers to produce more food so that the country can become self-sufficient in food ; as a result, the farmers have produced less coffee. Because of these factors, Colombia now gets much less cash from coffee exports than it did ten years ago.
